name: program-runtime.library-curate
purpose: Group agent-authored library candidates by their called-binding set and propose one promotion per group (the newest) with the rest listed as drops; report only.

max_groups.description: Largest number of groups reported; groups are ordered by size, then binding set.

assumptions: program-runtime is running and library list is reachable from the kernel
candidate rows carry calledBindingIds; a candidate without one groups under the empty set
the agent promotes with program-runtime library promote after reading the proposals; this program never writes
every successful submission, fixture runs included, enters the candidate tier; the candidate count grows with validation traffic
invariants: no binding with effect write or destructive is called
at most 500 candidate rows are read with head; no full materialization
the envelope is printed exactly once, on every path

signals.candidates: count of library rows with origin agent-authored
signals.groups: count of distinct called-binding sets among candidates
signals.proposals: list of {binding_set (first 6 ids), promote_id (the source program id to pass to library promote --program-id), group_size, drop_count, reason dedupe|single}; one per group, largest first
signals.drops: count of candidates not proposed for promotion
signals.promoted_duplicates: up to 5 lists of promoted names that share one binding set (the set-current route)
signals.ungrouped: count of agent-authored candidates with no calledBindingIds; never proposed for dedupe
signals.duplicate_binding_sets: count of called-binding sets shared by two or more promoted names; the number setpoint-read's library-hygiene row reads
